# DogsBay DITA tutorial — Part 4: Books and specialized topics

## Part 4: Books and specialized topics

- [Stage 18: Bookmap](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-18-bookmap.md): Publish the guide as a PDF book with a bookmap, book metadata, front matter, parts, chapters, appendixes, a glossary list and an index.
- [Stage 19: Troubleshooting](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-19-troubleshooting.md): Write a troubleshooting topic with a condition, causes and remedies, and turn a warning in the recording task into a trouble note that points at it.
- [Stage 20: Hazards and safety](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-20-hazards-and-safety.md): Create a hazard statement with a message panel and symbol, then reuse it in the recording task with conkeyref.
- [Stage 21: Software domains](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-21-software-domains.md): Document a command-line interface with the software and programming domains, a syntax diagram, a parameter list, messages, and code pulled from a file.
- [Stage 22: Learning](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-22-learning.md): Create a learning assessment with four question types and configure the gate to validate it with the DITA-OT catalog.
